description: On p1: under parent Edit the first attachment is replaced (child Edit, FileData.LoadFromFile of replace.bin, FileName set to 'renamed.dat', Update); a second is added by assigning FileData bytes and FileName directly; the group is read; the first attachment is deleted and the group read; then both attachments of p2 are deleted and its group read. Closed file image kept.
retentionNote: Designed r-cplx-rebuild probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
